residual_risks: With the ladder on, an unrecognised profile on a Do turn may bump gateway_effort_unknown_total twice, once from run_level and once if the turn's own plan() also runs effort_level. It is a metric over-count only and does not change behaviour.

do_run_level_uses_the_one_derivation finds the end of the launch call by the exact indentation "\n        );\n". read() normalises CRLF, so line endings are not a problem, but re-indenting the launch block would break the test. It would then fail loudly through expect, not pass silently.
The negative scan only looks for the literal `"deep" =>`. A profile match written another way, such as `"extended" |` arms, would not be caught. This is acceptable for a source-scan guard.

Line endings are preserved: sse.rs and effort_ladder_contract.rs stay LF, like HEAD, and thinking.rs stays all CRLF. The git autocrlf warning about these files is normal and not caused by this change.

The production clamp (admitted.clamp_effort at sse.rs:1266) runs only on the Ok(admitted) arm. The Err arm returns early, so the launch at sse.rs:1914 always sees the clamped effort. The contract test checks only that the clamp comes first in the source text, not the control flow.

summary: WS11-S8 gateway half is in. A fresh Do or Plan run now carries the turn's clamped effort level in RunAgentRequest.reasoning_effort, and a continuation carries none. The level comes from one new function, thinking::run_level, which reuses effort_level and returns 0 when MODEL_GATEWAY_EFFORT_LADDER is off (the profile is not consulted then). thinking.rs (CRLF kept): run_level plus three unit tests (deep is 4 with the ladder on and equals plan's effort_wire; every profile is 0 with the ladder off; standard, unset and blank are 0). sse.rs (LF kept): resolved_run_agent_request takes run_effort as its last parameter and sets it only when resume is None (let fresh = resume.is_none() is captured before resume moves). spawn_run_dispatch and agentic_run_stream take run_effort as their last parameter and pass it through. The production launch in invoke_stream_sse passes crate::thinking::run_level(req.effort.as_deref().unwrap_or_default(), crate::thinking::ladder_enabled()). req.effort is clamped by admitted.clamp_effort at line ~1250 in the same function, and admit runs unconditionally before the agentic branch. The continue_run launch and the two test launches pass 0. The build_run_agent_request literal is unchanged, and only its comment was updated. New tests: a_fresh_do_run_carries_the_turn_level and a_continuation_carries_no_level (continue_run_tests, via a request_at_level helper), and the_pure_builder_sends_no_level (agent_route_tests, beside build). Contract test: do_run_level_uses_the_one_derivation checks that the clamp precedes the launch, that the launch passes run_level with the clamped field and ladder_enabled, and that sse.rs neither matches a profile name nor calls effort_level. No existing source-scan assertion needed changing: the sse.rs scans and the continue_run scans stay green with their original text. Not touched: the chat effort derivation, ZDR turn settings, the budget and admission order, tool_loop.rs, AgentRoute, and no new switch.
